exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: exact historical Silent Storm soft painted COLOR effect bitmap edit, restrained finer original paint.

Image1 is the ENTIRE actual storedRGB original texture made opaque only by wholecanvas nearest-neighbor enlargement. Native originalA is zero but this RGB is genuinely useful in TransparentAdd, not an empty texture. Original COMPLETE A0 will be restored downstream; do not generate a transparent cutout or alpha premultiplication. Keep same entire square source canvas edge-to-edge and normalized UV, every source pigment value relationship, black gap, count/position/phase/scale and ORIGINAL SOFT BLUR.

ONE original softly painted orange diffuse color field, native32x32. Keep original subtly diagonal elongated orange middle and asymmetric dark-red/brown outer diffuse halo, exact footprint and soft irregular intensity phase. No new flames, luminous curls, white core, dust granules, rocks, sparks, isolated points or secondary puffs. It remains only the SAME plain blurred orange painted field, not a physical fire image or photograph.

Exact native dimensions are [32, 32]; original whole CHANNEL maxima RGB[228, 143, 81] (individual channel extrema, not permission for a newwhite point). Original brightest mean-RGB location native[17, 16] has RGB[228, 143, 81]. Preserve that same source local dominance and all dim original halos. One global scalar corrects brightness later, so do NOT locally strengthen the center, make dim edge support brighter, or add tonal fields. No new coarsecells/photonoise/materialgrain, sharpened rims, rays, curls or cauliflowerturbulence.

Output the ENTIRE opaque source storedRGB COLOR canvas at exactly same normalized fullUV; all original black/dim color support remains. No crop/zoom/padding/whitespace/frame/recenter/fit/BBox/registration/sourceRGB artistic patch. No new forms/text/marks/physical anatomy. Retain original material softness, native relative palette and pattern scale.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST16x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
